sex.description: Sex of the donor as recorded on the source portal: female, male, mixed, unknown, or unspecified.

age.description: Age of the donor, in the units given by age_units. Stored as a string, since the portal records open-ended values as well as exact ages.

age_units.description: Unit the age value is expressed in: day, week, month, or year.

ethnicities.description: Ethnicity of the donor, read from ethnicities for IGVF donors and from ethnicity for ENCODE donors.

phenotypic_features.description: Phenotypic features observed for the donor, as handles into ontology_terms. For IGVF donors these come from the donor's own phenotypic features; for ENCODE donors they come from the diseases recorded on the biosample, with DOID identifiers mapped onto MONDO or HP.
